name: Mother
intro: The Mother pathway governs life, plants, healing and natural transformation. It excels at regeneration, sustained support and biological or environmental control.

meter.name: Vitality
meter.gain: Actual healing of a living ally

ability.name: Earthy Vitality
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Earthy Vitality — +15% Max HP; +15% Poison direct-damage resistance, +15% Physical direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Nature Growth
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Nature Growth — Deals 135% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Nature damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Harvest Blessing
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Harvest Blessing — Immediately restores 10% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Life Seed
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Life Seed — Deals 160% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); Plant one seed on the most injured living ally for 2 turns; restore 4% Max HP on each turn. At 100 charge, increase one seed's regeneration to 6% Max HP per turn.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Life Bloom
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Life Bloom — Immediately restores 12% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Nature's Growth Surge
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Nature's Growth Surge — Immediately restores 10% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; 100% chance: Bound (blocks actions) for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Flesh Mutation
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Flesh Mutation — +25% DEF for 2 turns; Reflects 30% of incoming damage to the attacker until your next turn; periodic damage does not trigger reflection; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Mother's Touch
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Mother's Touch — Immediately restores 18% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; Removes Burn, Bleed, Poison, Curse, Curse link, Silenced, Confused, Sleep, Stunned, Frozen, Freeze, Bound; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 100% basic strike against the current enemy. 85 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.

ability.name: Creation Domain
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Creation Domain — Deals 310% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Nature damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Origin of Life
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Origin of Life — Deals 410% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Immediately restores 100% Max HP HP, capped at Max HP; this recovery occurs once per caster per battle, consumed only when HP is restored; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
